# Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route

> > Official guide to the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route, Japan's premier mountain sightseeing route connecting Tateyama and Kurobe through 3000m highlands.

The Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route features iconic destinations including Murodo Plateau, Mikuriga Pond, and the famous Yuki-no-Otani (Snow Corridor). Visitors traverse the Northern Japan Alps using eco-friendly transportation including the Tateyama Ropeway, Tateyama Tunnel Electric Bus, and panoramic observation vehicles.

## Key Topics

- Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route (立山黒部アルペンルート)
- Murodo Plateau (室堂)
- Midagahara (弥陀ヶ原)
- Yuki-no-Otani Snow Corridor (雪の大谷)
- Mikuriga Pond (みくりが池)
- Tateyama Station (立山駅)
- Ogizawa (扇沢)
- Daikanbo Observatory (大観峰)
- Tateyama Ropeway (立山ロープウェイ)
- Tateyama Tunnel Electric Bus (立山トンネル電気バス)
- Mountain trekking and hiking
- Seasonal photography and tourism
- Beginner-friendly routes
- Day-trip and overnight stays
- Sacred power spots and Oyama Shrine
